title: System administration
subtitle: Manage the members, shopping categories and shortcuts of your family space.

mcp.title: MCP connector (Claude)
mcp.subtitle: Generate a private URL to manage this family's events, presence, guests, shopping, tasks and meals directly from Claude, without a password. This URL gives full access to the family's data: only share it with people you trust and revoke it if it may have leaked.
mcp.copyNow: Copy this URL now: it will never be shown in full again.

mcp.none: No active MCP connector for this family.
mcp.regenerateMessage: The current URL will stop working immediately. Any Claude integration already set up with the old URL will need to be updated.
mcp.revokeMessage: The connector URL will stop working immediately for every configured Claude integration.

mealie.title: Mealie recipe server
mealie.subtitle: Connect your Mealie instance to search for a recipe when adding a meal: the dish, the recipe link and its ingredients are then filled in. The API token is created in Mealie, under {path}. It is stored encrypted and never sent to members' browsers.
mealie.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token
mealie.disconnectMessage: Mealie recipe search will no longer be offered when adding a meal. Recipe links already saved on meals are kept.

errors.load: Error while fetching the Mealie configuration
errors.save: Error while saving the Mealie configuration
errors.delete: Error while removing the Mealie configuration

categories.title: Shopping categories
categories.subtitle: Customise the shopping aisles and reorder them with drag and drop. The number sets the order in which they appear in the shopping list.
categories.empty: No categories set up. Click “+ New category” to add one.
categories.tip: Tip: grab a category by its ⠿ handle and drag it up or down to change its display order immediately.
categories.name: Category name

categories.itemsKept: Existing shopping items will be kept.

shortcuts.subtitle: Set up quick links (e.g. school portal, Drive, home automation…) shown in the navigation bar of every family member.

alexa.title: Alexa voice assistant
alexa.subtitle: Add events, shopping items, dishes, absences, presence and guests by voice from your Echo speakers. The skill stays private: it only works on your Amazon account, and the address generated here gives access to these additions for this family. Follow the ALEXA.md guide to create it in the Amazon developer console.
alexa.copyNow: Copy this address now and paste it into the Amazon console (Endpoint › HTTPS): it will never be shown in full again.

alexa.none: No Alexa skill is linked to this family.
alexa.modelHint: The model contains the family members’ first names: download it again and re-import it into the Amazon console when a new member joins.
alexa.regenerateMessage: The current address will stop working immediately: you will need to paste the new one into the Amazon console.
alexa.revokeMessage: The address will stop working immediately: Alexa will no longer be able to add anything for this family.
